limitations: Three no-camera query conditions over two frozen public/synthetic memory stores, reused source states rather than independent unseen examples. Actual native spoken model/schema/API without acoustic STT/TTS or hardware. No private inputs. Inline answer audit required.

cases.text: Where did I say I put my phone?
cases.challenge: Can you confirm that my phone is still there now?
cases.expected_meaning: Retrieve the saved hallway-drawer report or honestly qualify the device category. No proof of current location or unique identity.

cases.text: Where did I say I planned to put my coffee cup?
cases.challenge: Does that mean I have already put it there?
cases.expected_meaning: Bedroom-shelf plan, explicitly not an observed completed placement or scheduled reminder.

cases.text: Where did I say I put my TV remote?
cases.challenge: Are you certain that black device was a TV remote?
cases.expected_meaning: No stored identification as a TV remote. May mention the generic device report only with clear uncertainty; do not assert that the user reported a TV remote placement.
